aiResearchSummary.text: ZeroMark is engaged in the development of an adaptive targeting system, which includes components such as a forward grip assembly, a pistol grip assembly, and a buttstock assembly. The forward grip assembly features a motor, an inner shaft, and an outer shaft, enhancing precision and adaptability in weapon handling. This aligns with ZeroMark's focus on ensuring safety and precision in kinetic and non-lethal weaponry.
